game_title: Modulo Gate – Lava River Crossing Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Lava River Crossing open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Lava River Crossing open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about gates_open to power up the volcanologist and open the forge anvil.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Lava River Crossing'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
